description:
In the summary strip across the top of the Work In Progress report, the ESTIMATES figure looks exactly like the others — same grey label, same dark value colour, same size and weight as NOT STARTED, STARTED - EARNED, STARTED - REMAINING and READY TO INVOICE.

Nothing about it is toned down, so a reader cannot tell by looking that it is the one figure deliberately left out of the two headline totals.
env: Environment: QA branch sv8582 (https://sv8582.qa.shopview.com), build v3.5-f77875c. Desktop browser, signed in as an Admin.
steps: Open Reports, then Work In Progress, and set the date range to Last 12 Months so there are estimates to show, with both locations, Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and Staging Lethbridge - 4310 selected.
Compare the ESTIMATES figure at the right-hand end of the strip with NOT STARTED and READY TO INVOICE.
Here ESTIMATES read $527,356.34 alongside NOT STARTED $31,172.38 and READY TO INVOICE $56,494.23.
current:
The ESTIMATES label and amount are styled identically to the figures beside them.

The amount itself is correct — it matches the Estimates tab's own total exactly — and it is correctly left out of Total Earned and Total Remaining. Only the styling differs.
expected: The Estimates figure is shown in a muted style, visibly quieter than the figures that do count toward the totals.
source: Estimates is the total quoted value of the jobs in the "Estimates" tab, and is shown in a muted style.
